value: **Involvement**: Teachers actively participated in collaborative co-design workshops, design meetings, or teacher communities with researchers to iteratively develop, test, and adapt curriculum units, assessments, and lesson plans. **Evidence**: "This view of the teacher is directly related to the emerging scholarship around teachers as codesigners, and the value of co-design as a valuable space for expansive learning (see Ko et al., 2022)."
